title: Level 0, ticket only: a help center article is out of date

messages.text: Morning all, fresh coffee in the kitchen
The refund policy article on the help center still says 14 days, it should be 30
Customers keep quoting the 14 days back to us on calls

acme/help.content/articles/refund-policy.md:
# Refund policy

You can ask for a refund within 14 days of purchase.
acme/help.content/articles/shipping.md:
# Shipping

Orders ship within two business days.

files.note: The first paragraph still says 14 days.

triage.summary: Refund policy article says 14 days instead of 30
triage.description: The help center refund policy article states a 14 day window, but the policy is 30 days. Customers quote the old number on sales calls.
